china_race_dynamics.text: No surprise that Bernie @SenSanders and the Chinese communists want America to abandon AI development.  AI promises a quantum leap in productivity, medicine, transportation, resource management, leisure; in short, prosperity and progress.  Progressives can’t stand progress.  Their fearmongering set the American nuclear program back 50 years – we can’t afford to let them do the same with AI.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says Chinese communists want America to abandon AI and warns against letting fearmongering delay AI, endorsing a competitive posture.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly ties AI development to resisting Chinese pressure and says safety fearmongering must not delay progress.
